binds:scroll_event_delay.description: In ms, how many ms to wait after a scroll event to allow passing another one for the binds.

binds:workspace_back_and_forth.label: Workspace Back And Forth
binds:workspace_back_and_forth.description: If enabled, an attempt to switch to the currently focused workspace will instead switch to the previous workspace.

binds:hide_special_on_workspace_change.label: Hide Special On Workspace Change
binds:hide_special_on_workspace_change.description: If enabled, changing the active workspace will hide the special workspace on the monitor.

binds:allow_workspace_cycles.label: Allow Workspace Cycles
binds:allow_workspace_cycles.description: If enabled, workspaces don't forget their previous workspace.

binds:workspace_center_on.label: Workspace Center On
binds:workspace_center_on.description: Whether switching workspaces should center the cursor on the workspace (0) or on the last active window (1)

binds:focus_preferred_method.label: Focus Preferred Method
binds:focus_preferred_method.description: Sets the preferred focus finding method when using focuswindow/movewindow/etc with a direction.

binds:ignore_group_lock.label: Ignore Group Lock
binds:ignore_group_lock.description: If enabled, dispatchers like moveintogroup, moveoutofgroup and movewindoworgroup will ignore lock per group.

binds:movefocus_cycles_fullscreen.label: Movefocus Cycles Fullscreen
binds:movefocus_cycles_fullscreen.description: If enabled, when on a fullscreen window, movefocus will cycle fullscreen.

binds:movefocus_cycles_groupfirst.label: Movefocus Cycles Groupfirst
binds:movefocus_cycles_groupfirst.description: If enabled, when in a grouped window, movefocus will cycle windows in the groups first.

binds:disable_keybind_grabbing.label: Disable Keybind Grabbing
binds:disable_keybind_grabbing.description: If enabled, apps that request keybinds to be disabled will not be able to do so.

binds:window_direction_monitor_fallback.label: Window Direction Monitor Fallback
binds:window_direction_monitor_fallback.description: If enabled, moving a window or focus over the edge of a monitor with a direction will move it to the next monitor.

binds:allow_pin_fullscreen.label: Allow Pin Fullscreen
binds:allow_pin_fullscreen.description: Allows fullscreen to pinned windows, and restore their pinned status afterwards

binds:drag_threshold.label: Drag Threshold
binds:drag_threshold.description: Movement threshold in pixels for window dragging and c/g bind flags. 0 to disable.

binds:drag_center_window.label: Drag Center Window
binds:drag_center_window.description: If enabled, dragging a tiled or fullscreen window will center it on the cursor when it becomes floating.

xwayland:use_nearest_neighbor.label: Use Nearest Neighbor
xwayland:use_nearest_neighbor.description: Uses the nearest neighbor filtering for xwayland apps, making them pixelated rather than blurry

xwayland:force_zero_scaling.label: Force Zero Scaling
xwayland:force_zero_scaling.description: Forces a scale of 1 on xwayland windows on scaled displays.

xwayland:create_abstract_socket.label: Create Abstract Socket
xwayland:create_abstract_socket.description: Create the abstract Unix domain socket for XWayland

opengl:nvidia_anti_flicker.label: Nvidia Anti Flicker
opengl:nvidia_anti_flicker.description: Reduces flickering on nvidia at the cost of possible frame drops on lower-end GPUs.

render:expand_undersized_textures.label: Expand Undersized Textures
render:expand_undersized_textures.description: Whether to expand textures that have not yet resized to be larger.

render:xp_mode.label: Xp Mode
render:xp_mode.description: Disable back buffer and bottom layer rendering.

render:cm_enabled.label: CM Enabled
render:cm_enabled.description: Enable Color Management pipelines (requires restart to fully take effect)

render:send_content_type.label: Send Content Type
render:send_content_type.description: Report content type to allow monitor profile autoswitch

render:new_render_scheduling.label: New Render Scheduling
render:new_render_scheduling.description: Enable new render scheduling, which should improve FPS on underpowered devices.

render:cm_sdr_eotf.label: CM SDR EOTF
render:cm_sdr_eotf.description: Default transfer function for displaying SDR apps.

render:commit_timing_enabled.label: Commit Timing Enabled
render:commit_timing_enabled.description: Enable commit timing proto. Requires restart

render:icc_vcgt_enabled.label: ICC VCGT Enabled
render:icc_vcgt_enabled.description: Enable sending VCGT ramps to KMS with ICC profiles

cursor:min_refresh_rate.label: Min Refresh Rate
cursor:min_refresh_rate.description: Minimum refresh rate for cursor movement when no_break_fs_vrr is active.

cursor:hotspot_padding.label: Hotspot Padding
cursor:hotspot_padding.description: The padding, in logical px, between screen edges and the cursor

cursor:inactive_timeout.label: Inactive Timeout
cursor:inactive_timeout.description: In seconds, after how many seconds of cursor's inactivity to hide it. Set to 0 for never.

cursor:no_warps.label: No Warps
cursor:no_warps.description: If true, will not warp the cursor in many cases

cursor:persistent_warps.label: Persistent Warps
cursor:persistent_warps.description: When a window is refocused, the cursor returns to its last position relative to that window.

cursor:default_monitor.label: Default Monitor
cursor:default_monitor.description: The name of a default monitor for the cursor to be set to on startup

cursor:zoom_factor.label: Zoom Factor
cursor:zoom_factor.description: The factor to zoom by around the cursor. 1 means no zoom.

cursor:zoom_rigid.label: Zoom Rigid
cursor:zoom_rigid.description: Whether the zoom should follow the cursor rigidly or loosely

cursor:zoom_disable_aa.label: Zoom Disable Aa
cursor:zoom_disable_aa.description: If enabled, when zooming, no antialiasing will be used

cursor:zoom_detached_camera.label: Zoom Detached Camera
cursor:zoom_detached_camera.description: Detaches the camera from the mouse when zoomed in

cursor:hide_on_key_press.label: Hide On Key Press
cursor:hide_on_key_press.description: Hides the cursor when you press any key until the mouse is moved.

cursor:hide_on_touch.label: Hide On Touch
cursor:hide_on_touch.description: Hides the cursor when the last input was a touch input until a mouse input is done.

cursor:hide_on_tablet.label: Hide On Tablet
cursor:hide_on_tablet.description: Hides the cursor when the last input was a tablet input until a mouse input is done.

cursor:warp_back_after_non_mouse_input.label: Warp Back After Non Mouse Input
cursor:warp_back_after_non_mouse_input.description: Warp the cursor back to where it was after using a non-mouse input to move it.

ecosystem:no_update_news.label: No Update News
ecosystem:no_update_news.description: Disable the popup that shows up when you update hyprland to a new version.

ecosystem:no_donation_nag.label: No Donation Nag
ecosystem:no_donation_nag.description: Disable the popup that shows up twice a year encouraging to donate.

debug:gl_debugging.label: Gl Debugging
debug:gl_debugging.description: Enable OpenGL debugging and error checking.

debug:manual_crash.label: Manual Crash
debug:manual_crash.description: Set to 1 and then back to 0 to crash Hyprland.

debug:suppress_errors.label: Suppress Errors
debug:suppress_errors.description: If true, do not display config file parsing errors.

debug:disable_scale_checks.label: Disable Scale Checks
debug:disable_scale_checks.description: Disables verification of the scale factors.

debug:error_limit.label: Error Limit
debug:error_limit.description: Limits the number of displayed config file parsing errors.

debug:colored_stdout_logs.label: Colored Stdout Logs
debug:colored_stdout_logs.description: Enables colors in the stdout logs.

debug:full_cm_proto.label: Full CM Proto
debug:full_cm_proto.description: Claims support for all cm proto features (requires restart)

debug:ds_handle_same_buffer.label: Ds Handle Same Buffer
debug:ds_handle_same_buffer.description: Special case for DS with unmodified buffer

debug:ds_handle_same_buffer_fifo.label: Ds Handle Same Buffer Fifo
debug:ds_handle_same_buffer_fifo.description: Special case for DS with unmodified buffer unlocks fifo

debug:render_solitary_wo_damage.label: Render Solitary Wo Damage
debug:render_solitary_wo_damage.description: Render solitary window with empty damage

debug:vfr.label: VFR
debug:vfr.description: Controls the VFR status of Hyprland. Do not turn off unless debugging

layout:single_window_aspect_ratio.label: Single Window Aspect Ratio
layout:single_window_aspect_ratio.description: If specified, whenever only a single window is open, it will be coerced into the specified aspect ratio.

layout:single_window_aspect_ratio_tolera.label: Single Window Aspect Ratio Tolerance
layout:single_window_aspect_ratio_tolera.description: Minimum distance for single_window_aspect_ratio to take effect.

dwindle:preserve_split.label: Preserve Split
dwindle:preserve_split.description: If enabled, the split will not change regardless of what happens to the container.

dwindle:smart_split.label: Smart Split
dwindle:smart_split.description: If enabled, allows a more precise control over the window split direction based on the cursor's position.

dwindle:smart_resizing.label: Smart Resizing
dwindle:smart_resizing.description: If enabled, resizing direction will be determined by the mouse's position on the window.

dwindle:permanent_direction_override.label: Permanent Direction Override
dwindle:permanent_direction_override.description: If enabled, makes the preselect direction persist.

dwindle:special_scale_factor.label: Special Scale Factor
dwindle:special_scale_factor.description: Specifies the scale factor of windows on the special workspace
dwindle:special_scale_factor.deprecation_notice: Use workspace rules to achieve the same effect

dwindle:use_active_for_splits.label: Use Active For Splits
dwindle:use_active_for_splits.description: Whether to prefer the active window or the mouse position for splits

dwindle:default_split_ratio.label: Default Split Ratio
dwindle:default_split_ratio.description: The default split ratio on window open.

dwindle:precise_mouse_move.label: Precise Mouse Move
dwindle:precise_mouse_move.description: If enabled, bindm movewindow will drop the window more precisely depending on where your mouse is.

master:allow_small_split.label: Allow Small Split
master:allow_small_split.description: Enable adding additional master windows in a horizontal split style

master:special_scale_factor.label: Special Scale Factor
master:special_scale_factor.description: The scale of the special workspace windows.
master:special_scale_factor.deprecation_notice: Use workspace rules to achieve the same effect

master:mfact.label: Mfact
master:mfact.description: The size as a percentage of the master window.

master:new_status.label: New Status
master:new_status.description: `master`: new window becomes master; `slave`: new windows are added to slave stack; `inherit`: inherit from focused window

master:new_on_top.label: New On Top
master:new_on_top.description: Whether a newly open window should be on the top of the stack

master:new_on_active.label: New On Active
master:new_on_active.description: `before`, `after`: place new window relative to the focused window; `none`: place new window according to new_on_top.

master:orientation.label: Orientation
master:orientation.description: Default placement of the master area

master:slave_count_for_center_master.label: Slave Count For Center Master
master:slave_count_for_center_master.description: When using orientation=center, make the master window centered only when at least this many slave windows are open.

master:center_master_fallback.label: Center Master Fallback
master:center_master_fallback.description: Set fallback for center master when slaves are less than slave_count_for_center_master

master:center_ignores_reserved.label: Center Ignores Reserved
master:center_ignores_reserved.description: Centers the master window on monitor ignoring reserved areas

master:smart_resizing.label: Smart Resizing
master:smart_resizing.description: If enabled, resizing direction will be determined by the mouse's position on the window.

master:drop_at_cursor.label: Drop At Cursor
master:drop_at_cursor.description: When enabled, dragging and dropping windows will put them at the cursor position.

master:always_keep_position.label: Always Keep Position
master:always_keep_position.description: Whether to keep the master window in its configured position when there are no slave windows

master:focus_master_on_close.label: Focus Master On Close
master:focus_master_on_close.description: When enabled, closing a window focuses the master window

scrolling:fullscreen_on_one_column.label: Fullscreen On One Column
scrolling:fullscreen_on_one_column.description: When enabled, a single column on a workspace will always span the entire screen.

scrolling:column_width.label: Column Width
scrolling:column_width.description: The default width of a column.

scrolling:follow_focus.label: Follow Focus
scrolling:follow_focus.description: When a window is focused, should the layout move to bring it into view automatically

scrolling:follow_min_visible.label: Follow Min Visible
scrolling:follow_min_visible.description: When a window is focused, require that at least a given fraction of it is visible for focus to follow

scrolling:direction.label: Direction
scrolling:direction.description: Direction in which new windows appear and the layout scrolls

scrolling:wrap_focus.label: Wrap Focus
scrolling:wrap_focus.description: Determines if column focus wraps around

scrolling:wrap_swapcol.label: Wrap Swapcol
scrolling:wrap_swapcol.description: Determines if column movement wraps around

input-capture:capture_modifiers.label: Capture Modifiers
input-capture:capture_modifiers.description: If enabled, modifiers are also captured and sent to the program

input-capture:enforce_barriers.label: Enforce Barriers
input-capture:enforce_barriers.description: If enabled, throw a wayland error when a invalid barrier is received

quirks:skip_non_kms_dmabuf_formats.label: Skip Non Kms Dmabuf Formats
quirks:skip_non_kms_dmabuf_formats.description: Do not report dmabuf formats which cannot be imported into KMS
